examples.title: Track a source sequence
examples.code:
# Connect the Tracker to the footage you want to analyze.
tracker = nuke.createNode("Tracker4")
tracker.setInput(0, source)
tracker["channels"].setValue("rgb")

examples.title: Use the solved track as a stabilization
examples.code:
# After calculating tracking data, switch the Tracker to stabilize mode.
tracker = nuke.createNode("Tracker4")
tracker.setInput(0, source)
tracker["transform"].setValue("stabilize")

# Configure the "cornerPinOptions" control.
tracker4 = nuke.createNode("Tracker4")
tracker4["cornerPinOptions"].setValue("CornerPin2D (use transform ref frame)")
